title: Social Media & Marketing
tagline: The voice of Pawsitive. Online, always.
what: This team manages the club's social media presence across all platforms by curating and posting content such as artwork, articles, text posts, and commentary on relevant issues. They lead digital campaigns, ensure consistent documentation and coverage of club initiatives, and maintain an active online presence year-round. The team also manages the club's LinkedIn page to build a credible and professional public profile for external organisations and collaborators.
resp: Curating & posting content across all platforms — artwork, articles, reels, and commentary on relevant issues
Leading digital campaigns tied to events, awareness days, and adoption drives
Ensuring consistent documentation of all club initiatives year-round — photos, captions, stories
Managing the club's Instagram, LinkedIn, and any other active platforms with a coherent voice
Building a credible professional presence on LinkedIn for external collaborators and prospective sponsors
Analysing reach and engagement data to continuously improve content strategy
